headline: ILLEGAL BLOCKADE: Orla Mining Shares Tumble 7.5% as Union Shuts Down Mexico's Camino Rojo Gold Mine
snippet: Unionized workers erected an illegal blockade at Orla Mining's (TSX: OLA) Camino Rojo gold mine in Zacatecas, Mexico, halting all operations after profit-sharing negotiations broke down. The company called the stoppage illegal, shares fell 7.5% Monday, and a government-mediated hearing is set for June 2.

headline: 1,867 G/T SILVER OVER 6 METRES: Aya Gold Posts Best-Yet Deep Exploration Results at Morocco's Zgounder Mine
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver's at-depth drilling at Morocco's Zgounder Silver Mine returned 1,867 g/t Ag over 6.0m (including 5,100 g/t over 2.0m) and 739 g/t Ag over 10.0m from near-pit depths. New intercepts extend mineralization westward into fresh ground and reinforce Zgounder's long-term resource growth case.

headline: IAMGOLD BUMPS CÔTÉ TO 20.3 MOZ: Gosselin Zone Integration Lifts Ontario Giant's Resource 12%
snippet: IAMGOLD's consolidated Côté-Gosselin mineral resource estimate now stands at 20.34 million ounces M&I gold — up 12% versus December 2025 — after folding the Gosselin zone into a single block model. Inferred resources surged 61% to 3.48 Moz, underpinning an expansion technical report due Q4 2026.

headline: GOLD SLIPS BELOW $4,500 as Iran Closes Strait of Hormuz, Oil Spikes to $97
snippet: Spot gold fell nearly 2% to $4,455/oz after Iran reportedly suspended US negotiations and fully closed the Strait of Hormuz, sending oil to $97/barrel. The resulting inflation fears and stronger dollar pushed the rate-cut timeline further out and knocked precious metals off last week's high.

headline: GOLD AT THE CROSSROADS: World Gold Council Calls 200-Day MA Test a Market 'Point of Inflection'
snippet: The World Gold Council's weekly monitor argues gold's test of its 200-day moving average is more consequential than it looks: futures net-long positioning heading into the test was neutral rather than crowded, meaning a hold signals genuine demand support — not just reluctant sellers — while a breakdown would be a true bearish signal.

headline: EAST TAKES THE GOLD: China's Hong Kong Imports Surge 81% as New Clearing House Prepares to Launch
snippet: Chinese gold imports through Hong Kong jumped 81.2% month-on-month in April as the city accelerates its push to become a global bullion hub. Money Metals' Mike Maharrey notes a structural shift in gold trade from West to East that long predates the current price rally and is now gaining institutional infrastructure.

headline: PAN AMERICAN COMMITS $146M to Sink Bell Creek Shaft Deeper and Unlock Timmins Gold Growth
snippet: Pan American Silver's board approved Phase 1 of the Timmins Camp Project: a 625m Bell Creek shaft extension plus exploration drifts to the Vogel and Samson satellite deposits totalling $146 million US. The first $40–43M tranche is already in 2026 guidance, with mill capacity currently running 1,200 t/d under nameplate.

headline: COPPER SURGES TO $6.56/LB as Chile Posts Weakest Output in 23 Years and US Tariff Clock Ticks
snippet: Copper futures climbed to $6.56/lb — a multi-week high — after Chile's April production hit a 23-year low and AI datacenter buildout boosted demand projections by 110,000 additional tonnes this year. A US Commerce Department recommendation on 15–30% refined copper tariffs is due June 30.

headline: NUCLEAR GOLD RUSH: Meta Locks In 7.8 GW of Nuclear as Uranium Spot Holds Above $85/lb
snippet: Uranium spot settled at $85.08/lb as tech-giant nuclear procurement accelerates: Meta signed agreements for 7.8 gigawatts of nuclear capacity and Microsoft locked in 800+ megawatts for AI datacenters. Cameco's president says utility uncovered requirements have 'never been bigger,' keeping the long-term market structurally tight.

headline: NORTHERN STAR SURGES 12.4% to 52-Week High on Pogo Mine and Western Australia Gold Drilling
snippet: Northern Star Resources (ASX: NST) led ASX 200 gainers on June 2 after releasing positive drill intercepts from its Pogo gold mine in Alaska and its Western Australian operations. The stock hit a new 52-week high as analysts noted results exceeded expectations and reinforce NST's organic growth pipeline.

headline: DRILL RODS IN GROUND: Yukon Metals Breaks Ground on 5,000-Metre Copper-Gold Program at AZ and Birch
snippet: Yukon Metals began diamond drilling at its AZ and Birch copper-gold properties in Yukon's prolific mining corridor on May 28, with the first core already produced at AZ. The program targets ~2,000m at AZ and ~3,000m at Birch, with results expected through the summer field season.
